commentary_title: Capesize utilisation improves sharply as Atlantic activity strengthens
commentary_summary: Capesize utilisation rose sharply to 92.9% from 91.6% a week earlier, and also moved above the 92.5% recorded in the corresponding period last year. Capesize rates strengthened alongside the improvement in utilisation. | Effective vessel supply tightened as congestion increased across several regions, even though global ballast and laden speeds increased during the week. | Capesize rates also found support from stronger Atlantic cargo activity, with improving long-haul demand tightening the tonnage position. The key factor to watch next week will be whether Atlantic cargo coverage continues into December loading, which would help sustain the recent improvement in Capesize rates.
